title: Ada and the Compass
author: E. M. Sterling
blurb: Freya Galloway, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
